summary: Module 1 FIX: corrected the wrong claim precisely and diagnosed the failure mode. Step 1: the wrong claim is exactly -- 'the workspace is only a platform folder with AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, reports, and progress/; it has no real application files to test' -- which is factually false (api/ app + infra/ + scripts/ + Dockerfile + railway.json + 76 tests exist). Step 2: wrote the corrected follow-up prompt constraining the agent to look specifically at api/ and api/app/ and api/tests/, cite exact observed files/directories, and say so when a listing shows nothing (no assumption-based filling). Step 3: failure mode = insufficient context / pattern-based guessing, NOT hallucination (claim was generic, not suspiciously specific) and NOT ambiguous code (no ambiguity; the agent never looked at api/). Most common + most fixable: better context fixes it. Step 4: re-run result -- the corrected prompt, backed by commands (root listing, 34 source files under api/, pytest 76 tests exit 0), yields the corrected statement: workspace contains a complete runnable testable FastAPI application under api/. Calibration conclusion: this claim was fixable with a better prompt (context failure, not hallucination) but I still verified through commands because the cost of a wrong 'no code exists' conclusion is total and a single listing settles it definitively. Recorded in progress/fix-record.md.
